FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our meditation programs and center.
FAQ.q1: What should I wear for meditation?
FAQ.a1: We recommend wearing loose, comfortable clothing that allows you to sit easily on a cushion or chair. White or light-colored clothing is traditional but not mandatory. Please avoid revealing attire out of respect for the monastic environment.
FAQ.q2: Do I need prior experience to join?
FAQ.a2: Not at all! We welcome beginners and experienced practitioners alike. Our programs are designed to guide you through the basics of mindfulness and meditation, regardless of your experience level.
FAQ.q3: Is there a cost for the programs?
FAQ.a3: Most of our daily meditation sessions are offered free of charge, supported by donations (Dana). Some special retreats or workshops may have a fee to cover food and accommodation costs, but we offer scholarships for those in need.
FAQ.q4: Can I stay overnight at the center?
FAQ.a4: Yes, we have accommodation facilities for retreat participants. Overnight stays must be booked in advance as part of a scheduled retreat program. Please contact us for availability and booking details.
FAQ.q5: What types of meditation do you teach?
FAQ.a5: We primarily teach Vipassana (Insight) and Samatha (Tranquility) meditation, rooted in the Theravada Buddhist tradition. We also offer Metta (Loving-Kindness) meditation sessions to cultivate compassion.
